segments.text: This is a supplemental video presentation for the Case Animal and Plant Biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动物与植物生物技术课程的补充视频讲解。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Sterile Technique for Plant Cloning Lesson 4.2 Performance Enhanced Plants
segments.zh: 植物克隆的无菌技术　第 4.2 课　性能增强型植物

segments.text: Your teacher introduced Activity 4.2.2 Culturing Ferns.
segments.zh: 你的老师已经介绍了活动 4.2.2“培养蕨类植物”。

segments.text: This video provides a review of sterile technique if a review is necessary.
segments.zh: 如果需要复习，本视频提供了对无菌技术的回顾。

segments.text: A transfer chamber, laminar flow hood, or bacterial safety cabinet is used to minimize the potential of contaminants being introduced into the culture dishes.
segments.zh: 使用转移箱、超净工作台或生物安全柜，可以尽量减少污染物进入培养皿的可能性。

segments.text: Nutrient-rich auger is necessary to support cell growth for tissue culture.
segments.zh: 组织培养需要营养丰富的琼脂来支持细胞生长。

segments.text: However, the conditions are perfect to support the growth of bacteria and fungi.
segments.zh: 然而，这些条件也非常适合细菌和真菌的生长。

segments.text: Bacteria has contaminated the culture in this picture.
segments.zh: 这张图片中的培养物已经被细菌污染了。

segments.text: Contaminants can feed on tender plant cells and ultimately kill the culture.
segments.zh: 污染物会以娇嫩的植物细胞为食，最终导致培养物死亡。

segments.text: Other harmful effects can be from bacteria that is harmful to humans.
segments.zh: 其他有害影响可能来自对人体有害的细菌。

segments.text: Harmful bacteria, such as strep, can rapidly multiply in the environment meant for cell growth.
segments.zh: 有害细菌，比如链球菌，会在原本供细胞生长的环境中迅速繁殖。

segments.text: Although surfaces appear clean, contaminants are everywhere on every surface.
segments.zh: 虽然表面看起来很干净，但污染物无处不在，存在于每一个表面上。

segments.text: Bacterial and fungal spores can persist in the air, and even the plant tissue intended to be cultured.
segments.zh: 细菌和真菌孢子可以在空气中长期存在，甚至存在于准备培养的植物组织中。

segments.text: The goal of sterilization is to destroy all contaminants.
segments.zh: 灭菌的目标是消灭所有污染物。

segments.text: This is very difficult to accomplish, and at best we can hope to minimize the risk.
segments.zh: 这是非常难以做到的，我们最多只能希望把风险降到最低。

segments.text: The best way to sterilize is to use intense heat or pressure.
segments.zh: 最好的灭菌方法是使用高温或高压。

segments.text: Unfortunately, intense heat and pressure will also destroy the living plant tissue.
segments.zh: 遗憾的是，高温和高压也会破坏活的植物组织。

segments.text: Sterilization for tissue culture is primarily done by the use of alcohol-based chemicals.
segments.zh: 组织培养的灭菌主要是使用酒精类化学品来完成的。

segments.text: Be aware that clean conditions are important.
segments.zh: 要意识到洁净的条件非常重要。

segments.text: If potential contamination risks are eliminated, then the risk of cultural contamination is also minimized.
segments.zh: 如果消除了潜在的污染风险，那么培养物被污染的风险也会降到最低。

segments.text: Sterile surfaces, instruments, and vessels maintain the sterile workspace.
segments.zh: 无菌的表面、器械和容器可以维持无菌的工作空间。

segments.text: Personal hygiene decreases contamination from microbes found in your hair, on your skin, and in your nose and mouth.
segments.zh: 保持个人卫生可以减少来自头发、皮肤以及鼻腔和口腔中微生物的污染。

segments.text: Slow, steady movements also decrease airflow over medium and sterile surfaces.
segments.zh: 缓慢、平稳的动作也能减少培养基和无菌表面上方的气流。

segments.text: If multiple groups use the same transfer chamber, members should observe sterile technique.
segments.zh: 如果多个小组使用同一个转移箱，组员们都应遵守无菌技术。

segments.text: Between steps and groups, instruments should be kept in isopropyl solution.
segments.zh: 在各个步骤之间以及换组时，器械应浸泡在异丙醇溶液中。

segments.text: Culture plates should be removed when you are finished.
segments.zh: 操作完成后，应把培养皿拿走。

segments.text: Every time someone enters the chamber, they should sanitize their gloves and the work area.
segments.zh: 每次有人进入操作箱时，都应对手套和工作区域进行消毒。

segments.text: Safety concerns with contaminated cultures must be paramount.
segments.zh: 受污染培养物带来的安全问题必须放在首位。

segments.text: Bacterial and fungal organisms could wipe out the entire population.
segments.zh: 细菌和真菌可能会毁掉整个培养群体。

segments.text: Contaminated cultures must be removed from the growth chamber immediately and placed in an autoclave to destroy the contaminating organisms.
segments.zh: 受污染的培养物必须立即从培养箱中取出，并放入高压灭菌器中，以消灭污染微生物。

segments.text: As you review, mark or highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 复习时，请在笔记中标出或突出本讲解中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic and discuss them with your teacher.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何问题，并与老师讨论。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把本讲解的所有笔记整理好，在整个课程中随时备用。

segments.text: Now you should be ready to proceed with Activity 4.2.2 Culturing Firms.
segments.zh: 现在你应该可以开始进行活动 4.2.2“培养蕨类植物”了。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供进一步的说明。
